content.comment_body: How can I create a backup from the [product_name] slave device? Currently, I can only back up the master device.
Please avoid posting multiple times about the same issue. You have also created a separate topic: [product_name] Master-Slave.
This thread is closed because the question was posted twice. The active discussion is linked in the previous post. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user has identified a constraint in the backup process for a master-slave setup, where backup is only possible from the master device, and there does not appear to be an accessible method or documentation for backing up the slave device.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to independently create backups from both master and slave devices in a [product_name] master-slave configuration.
